meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.
She was running after me (around me).

meanings.note: neuter главное, used as a noun

examples.trans: The main thing is, don't worry.
This is Vanya, my childhood friend.
I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Из-за вашей Лёли весь класс зовёт меня врунишкой!
examples.trans: Because of your Lyolya the whole class calls me a little liar!
We were late because of the rain.

meanings.note: for movement; где is for location

examples.trans: Three rooms and a big kitchen.

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.trans: The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
used with не before the verb, or alone

examples.text: Я никогда не был на море.
examples.trans: I've never been to the sea.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо ещё.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need more.
I want to, but I can't.
I'll definitely buy you a tank.

meanings.note: agrees in gender and case with the noun

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

meanings.note: ничего не осталось = there's nothing left

examples.trans: I love our town very much.

переживать.gloss: to worry, to fret; to go through

examples.trans: Why are you worrying like that?
Don't worry, everything will be fine.
There you go! No support at all!

meanings.note: понимаешь? = you know? do you understand?

examples.trans: I want to go to the sea, you know?

пошутить.gloss: to joke, to make a joke

meanings.note: я пошутил(а) = I was only joking

examples.text: Я смотрю, вы легковерный! Я же пошутила!
examples.trans: I see you're gullible! I was only joking!
Don't be offended, I was only joking.

придумать.gloss: to think up, to come up with

examples.trans: You came up with this yourself!

examples.trans: Children love hiding in the wardrobe.

examples.text: Мы рады видеть вас в нашем ресторане.
examples.trans: We are glad to see you in our restaurant.
